主要内容: On February 1, 2012, Schweitzer-Mauduit International, Inc. responded to the International Trade Commission's initial decision in a Section 337(b) case. The ITC found that SWM's patent claims were not infringed by Julius Glatz, LIPtec, and KneX Worldwide. The full decision remains confidential until reviewed by the parties, so the reasoning behind the ruling is not yet known. SWM issued a press release detailing its response, which is attached as Exhibit 99.1. The filing does not constitute a 'filed' document under Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, nor is it incorporated by reference in any other filing unless explicitly stated.
